alignments.note: Interrogative particle takes the fronted question auxiliary *Shall* (rule 17).
Anarthrous substantive with the supplied *he that* the ASV writes to make it a noun phrase (rule 46); headed on the lexeme-bearing *cavilleth*.
Infinitive absolute used as the predicate; the ASV writes the plain verb *contend*.
Supplied *the* determines this nominal (rule 15); headed on the name.

Anarthrous participial substantive with supplied *He that* (rule 46); the *with* is the preposition the English verb needs to reach its bare object `אֱלוֹהַּ` and belongs to the verb's rendering (rule 44). Head on *argueth* under rule 46.
Jussive with its English volitive frame and subject pronoun (rule 17); head on the lexical verb.

review_notes: The *with* of *argueth with God* is taken as the English verb's valency preposition for a bare Hebrew object (rule 44) rather than as anything the noun licenses.
